raw_html: [[ Shrieking Bolt]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[ Shrieking Bolt]]:''' This item resonates with sonic energy. On ranged attacks, on an attack roll of 20 which is confirmed as a critical hit it will punish the target with a blast of sound (10 to 60 sonic damage). A successful [[Fortitude save]] (DC 22) reduces this damage by half.
